segments.name: Digital
segments.description: Delivers technology-enabled, subscription-based access to Korn Ferry's talent intelligence and data assets.
segments.evidence: Talent Suite enables those insights to be embedded within client workflows, accessed directly through subscription-based offerings, or leveraged by Korn Ferry consultants to help clients improve performance and make more effective people and organizational decisions.

segments.name: Executive Search North America
segments.description: Recruits board-level, C-suite and senior executive talent for clients in North America.
segments.evidence: This solution is managed and reported on a geographic basis and represents four of the Company's reportable segments (Executive Search North America, Executive Search Europe, Middle East and Africa ("EMEA"), Executive Search Asia Pacific ("APAC") and Executive Search Latin America).

segments.evidence: This solution is managed and reported on a geographic basis and represents four of the Company's reportable segments (Executive Search North America, Executive Search Europe, Middle East and Africa ("EMEA"), Executive Search Asia Pacific ("APAC") and Executive Search Latin America).

segments.name: Executive Search Latin America
segments.description: Recruits board-level, C-suite and senior executive talent for clients in Latin America.
segments.evidence: This solution is managed and reported on a geographic basis and represents four of the Company's reportable segments (Executive Search North America, Executive Search Europe, Middle East and Africa ("EMEA"), Executive Search Asia Pacific ("APAC") and Executive Search Latin America).

segments.name: Professional Search & Interim
segments.description: Places permanent professionals and interim leaders across business-critical functions such as Finance, IT, HR and Operations.
segments.evidence: Professional Search & Interim focuses on scalable, high impact recruiting and interim talent solutions at the professional level that offer flexibility and speed in dynamic business environments.

segments.name: RPO
segments.description: Provides high-volume, outsourced end-to-end talent acquisition services for enterprise clients through global Talent Delivery Centers.
segments.evidence: RPO provides high-volume, outsourced hiring solutions that deliver end-to-end talent acquisition services for enterprise clients.
